summary: Shop screen for any game: the title's storefront with stores as tabs, offer cards, purchase confirmation and the reward animation.
description: A ready shop for ANY game, built on the @idosgames/react/ui kit. It draws the storefront the server resolves for the player (client.store.getStorefront — rotation, limits, timers and badges are the server's), several stores as tabs, the first section of a store as a carousel and the rest as grids, a free daily gift that shines, sold-out and not-yet-available states with countdowns, a confirmation popup (a bottom sheet on phones) and the 'You got' animation where rewards fly to the balance counters. Registers itself as the 'store' feature of the game (ctx.features): the lobby of the base shows it as a tab, and any module can open it with ctx.features.open('store'). Its badge counts free offers waiting. Ships title-seed.json: a demo store with a daily gift, items and currency packs.
provides: shop screen from the title storefront
offer carousel and grids with countdowns
reward animation with icons flying to balances
